requirement_vague: Verify that a second user cannot read another user's item. Confirm access is denied.

omissions.description: Reading an item by a second, non-owner user is not denied; the GET /api/v1/items/{item_id} endpoint returns the item without checking ownership or permissions, instead of responding with status 400 and detail "Not enough permissions".
omissions.reasoning: The requirement is about access control for reading another user's item. In read_item, the code only checks whether the item exists and then returns it. Unlike update_item and delete_item, there is no permission check comparing item.owner_id to current_user.id and no HTTPException with status_code=400 and detail="Not enough permissions".
